question: Which qualities can draw in all powers at once?
premises: Qualities such as fullness, luminosity, consciousness-nature, and Bhairava-nature are pervasive.
Pervasive qualities can encompass other powers.
Therefore these qualities draw in all powers.
inference: Contemplation of the Lord's pervasive qualities encompasses all powers because of their all-pervading nature.
plain_english: Therefore qualities such as fullness, luminosity, consciousness-nature, and Bhairava-nature draw in all powers because of their pervasiveness.
